title: Adaptive $k$ Nearest Neighbors Classifier via Granular Ball Computing
abstract: arXiv:2608.12903v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The $k$-Nearest Neighbor~(KNN) algorithm is widely used across various tasks. The selection of the $k$ value is a key issue because it significantly impacts performance. In this paper, an adaptive and efficient KNN approach via granular-ball computing is proposed. The method consists of two stages. \textcolor{black}{In the training stage, the dataset is first coarsely partitioned to reduce the complexity of data distributions within a granular ball, and then the Fisher criterion is introduced to control ball splitting and stopping, yielding a multi-granularity granular ball representation. In the prediction stage, the nearest granular ball is first located through a weighted distance mechanism, and an adaptive neighborhood is then constructed around the test sample. translated_title: 基于粒球计算的自适应k近邻分类器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12903v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：k近邻（KNN）算法广泛应用于各种任务中。k值的选择是一个关键问题，因为它显著影响性能。本文提出了一种通过粒球计算的自适应且高效的KNN方法。该方法包括两个阶段。在训练阶段，首先对数据集进行粗粒度划分，以降低粒球内数据分布的复杂性，然后引入Fisher准则来控制粒球分裂和停止，从而生成多粒度粒球表示。在预测阶段，首先通过加权距离机制定位最近的粒球，然后在测试样本周围构建自适应邻域。有效k值由该邻域中实际包含的样本数量动态确定。由最近粒球诱导的邻域提供了局部数据分布的紧凑近似，从而提高了分类精度。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于粒球计算的自适应KNN方法，通过训练阶段的Fisher准则控制粒球分裂和预测阶段的加权距离邻域构建，动态确定k值，以提高分类性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive KNN method based on granular-ball computing, which dynamically determines the k value via Fisher criterion-controlled ball splitting in training and weighted-distance-based neighborhood construction in prediction to improve classification accuracy.
